name: Uncommon New Firewall Rule Added In Windows Firewall Exception List
description: Detects when a rule has been added to the Windows Firewall exception list
author: GAI_CTI
query: winlog.channel:Microsoft\-Windows\-Windows\ Firewall\ With\ Advanced\ Security\/Firewall AND ((event.code:(2004 OR 2071 OR 2097)) AND (NOT (winlog.event_data.Action:2 OR (winlog.event_data.ApplicationPath:(C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\* OR C\:\\Program\ Files\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\System32\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*)) OR (winlog.event_data.ApplicationPath:(*C\:\\PerfLogs\\* OR *C\:\\Temp\\* OR *C\:\\Tmp\\* OR *C\:\\Users\\Public\\* OR *C\:\\Windows\\Tasks\\* OR *C\:\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*)) OR (NOT _exists_:winlog.event_data.ApplicationPath))) AND (NOT ((winlog.event_data.ModifyingApplication:C\:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows\ Defender\\Platform\\* AND winlog.event_data.ModifyingApplication:*\\MsMpEng.exe) OR ((winlog.event_data.ModifyingApplication:(C\:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe OR C\:\\Windows\\System32\\dllhost.exe)) AND winlog.event_data.ApplicationPath:""))))
